items.title: LA Clippers’ 94 turnovers through the first 4 games are the most by any team since 1996. Their 76 turnovers over the last 3 games are the most by a team since 2021. They are the first team since 2002 to have three consecutive games with 24+ turnovers.
items.author: Justin Russo
items.body_excerpt: LA Clippers’ 94 turnovers through the first 4 games are the most by any team since 1996. Their 76 turnovers over the last 3 games are the most by a team since 2021. They are the first team since 2002 to have three consecutive games with 24+ turnovers.

quote.author: Justin Russo
quote.text: F: Lakers 103, Clippers 87. That was about as putrid of an offensive display as you’re likely to see all season. Last time they shot this poorly (35.6%) with this many turnovers (24) was April 1999. Rude awakening: 11 players on the team weren’t even alive then. Clippers are 1-3.
